5.issue: EBS snapshot created from an unencrypted volume
5.risk: Because the source EBS volume is unencrypted, the resulting snapshot is also unencrypted. Unencrypted snapshots can be copied or shared, exposing data at rest without any cryptographic protection.
5.remediation: First encrypt the source volume (aws_ebs_volume.web_host_storage) by setting encrypted = true. Snapshots of encrypted volumes are automatically encrypted. Alternatively, use the aws_ebs_snapshot_copy resource with encrypted = true and a kms_key_id to create an encrypted copy.

14.risk: Setting force_destroy = true allows Terraform to delete the bucket and all its contents (including flow logs) in a single destroy operation. This can lead to accidental or malicious permanent deletion of audit logs required for compliance and forensic investigation.
14.remediation: Set force_destroy = false on aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket to prevent accidental deletion of flow log data. Implement S3 Object Lock or a bucket policy to enforce retention if compliance requires it.
